title: Computer Science & Artificial Intelligence
identity: Learning systems understood from the inside: the mathematics behind them, the experiments that test them, and the engineering that makes results reproducible. Model behaviour, measurement, evidence and causal claims are kept apart. Fast-moving material carries an explicit currency check.
conventions: Every reported metric names its dataset split, baseline and random seed policy.
Train, validation and test data never mix; leakage is a correctness error, not a nuance.
Notebooks are reproducible from a clean environment or they are not results.
